scripts.build: npx esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/app.js --minify --format=iife --target=es2022 && npx esbuild src/audio-worklet.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/audio-worklet.js --minify --format=iife --target=es2022 && cp index.html dist/ && cp src/styles.css dist/ && cp -r assets/ dist/assets/
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=avatar-web-client
